title: A Stuck Ship Held Up $9 Billion of Trade Every Day

scenes.text: A ship stuck sideways held up $9 billion of trade every day.
In March 2021, the Ever Given ran aground in the Suez Canal.
It stayed stuck for six days.
Ten tugboats pulled at it during a full moon high tide.
One wedged ship, one jammed world. Watch it get stuck again.

description:
The Ever Given blocked the Suez Canal for six days in March 2021, holding up about $9 billion of trade each day.
Ten tugboats and a high tide finally freed it.
What would you have tried first?
first_comment: What's the biggest thing you've ever seen stuck somewhere?
